text:
ANERJİRY-E OMOOMI-YE RUZ
Emruz asman baraye shoma-ye mofid va barname-riz-e Xosh-qalb, faz-e besyar mosbat va sazandeyi ra neshon midahad. Ennerzhi-ye emruz be shoma komak mikonad ta kar-ha-ye natamam-e khod ra ba deqqat-e tamam be payan beresanid va ehsas-e aramesh-e daruni-ye zibayi ra tajrobe konid. Ruh-e shoma emruz taleb-e nazm, zibayi va pishraft ast, بنابر این az in moqeiyat baraye moruri bar ahdaf-e boland-moddat-e khod estefade konid. Hal-e del-e shoma emruz roshan va omid-var ast va mitavanid ba didgahi baz-tar be donya negah konid.

EHQ VA RAVABET
Baraye shoma-ye mofid ke dar rabete hastid, emruz forsat-e aliei ast ta ba hamsefr-e zendegi-ye khod darbare-ye ayandeye moshtarak goft-e-gu konid va piyvand-e ahsasi-ye khod ra mohkam-tar konid. Yehoome koli ahsas-e garmaye bishtari mikonid va in mozoo be shoma komak mikonad ta harگونه sotefahem-e ghabli ra ba goft-e-gu-ye samimane hal konid. Baraye mojarad-ha, emruz mitavanad rozi por az etejafat-e ghalbi bashad؛ shomare-ye jadidi dar masir-e shoma gharar migirad ke mitavanad ghalb-e shoma ra be talatash biandazad, pas ghalb-e khod ra be rouy-e eshq-e tazeh baz negah darid.

KAR VA KARIYAR
Dar mohit-e kar, emruz zireki va deqqat-e bi-nazir-e shoma dar joz-eiat be cheshm miayad va raeys-ha ya hamkaran-e shoma az in vizhegi qadr-dani khahand kard. Agar tarh-e jadidi dar sar darid ya bayad tasmim-e mohemi begirid, emruz behtarin zaman baraye ejra va amali kardane an ast. Forsa-ha-ye pish-bini nashodei baraye pishraft-e kari bar sar-e rah-e shoma sabz mishavad ke ba modiriyat-e zirekani mitavanid anha ra be nfe khod tamdid konid.

PUL VA BEREKAT
Vaziate mali-ye shoma emruz dar halat-e mosbat va pazirftei gharar darad va mitavanid baraye sar-mayegozari-ye kuchak ya pasandaz-e hooshmandane barname-rizi konid. Ehsas-e amniyat-e mali be shoma aramesh midahad, ama behtar ast az kharj-ha-ye ezafi va bi-dalil khoddari konid ta in tavazon hefz shavad. Barekat dar kar va kasb-e shoma dar jaryan ast, مشروط بر anke ba ehtiyat va fan-e tadbir gham bar darid.

SALAMATI VA ENERZHI
Jesm va ruh-e shoma emruz niaz be tamarkoz bar ruye aramsh-e daruni darad؛ behtar ast kamish varzesh-e sabok ya yuga anjam dahid ta enerzhi-ye manfi az shoma dur shavad. Be ghabl-e khod ghashang goosh konid va agar ehsas-e khastegi kardid, hatman zamani ra baraye estrahat va bazyaft-e niru dar nazar begirid. Taghzie-ye salem va noshidane ab-e kafi be shoma komak mikonad ta tamame ruz roohie-ye por-nerzhi dashte bashid.

ERTEBATAT VA MOHIT
Ravabet ba doostan va ahlel-e khanevade dar behtarin halat-e khod ast va har goone su-tefahem ya codeurati az mian miravad. Emruz mitavanid mehmani-ye kochaki doreham tanzim konid ya ba afrod-e nazdik-e khod vaqt-e kafi va ba-keyfiyat biandazid. Hozur-e shoma dar jam-ha ba eshg va garmaye khassi hamrah ast va digaran az hamsohbati ba shoma lezat mibarand.

TAVSIYE-YE RUZ
Kharad-e daruni-ye khod ra bavar konid؛ lazem nist hame-ye chiz ra dar yek ruz hal konid, gham-e ghadam-ha-ye koochak amamostahkam bashid.

JOZEYAT-E RUZ
Adad-e shans: 5
Rang-e shans: Abi-ye asemani va Sabz-e zeytuni
Borz-e hamahang: Jowza va Ghorbeleh
